label_method: Port + UTC timestamp heuristic vs CICFlowMeter reference (CSV=EST, PCAP=UTC, offset=+5h)
timezone_note: CICFlowMeter CSV timestamps are EST (UTC-5). PCAP timestamps are UTC. FTP attack window 15:33-17:10 UTC is present in these files.
limitation: Wednesday PCAP covers 12:29-21:30 UTC only. FTP-BruteForce (UTC 15:33-17:10) IS in this window and labeled via port 21 + timestamp. SSH-Bruteforce (UTC 07:01-08:32) is before the PCAP window and NOT captured. Only Benign + Brute Force (FTP) classes are available from this subset. Botnet and Web Attack classes require additional days (Friday-02-03, Thursday-22-02, Friday-23-02).
